desc: Ideation phase: initial flawed top1/top2 approach.
Build a trie for all words. Store for each node: children (dict), depth, count.
Compute `max_k_plus_1`: maximum depth among nodes with count ≥ k+1.
Identify special nodes (count == k) and compute `subtree_max[node]`.
Compute `max_outside_path[node]` and final answer for each word.
Handle k > n-1: return all zeros.
Test with edge cases: all identical, all distinct, k=1, k=n, counterexample ["ab","ac","ad"] with k=2 (expect 1), words with varying lengths and shared prefixes.
Verify performance and space usage under constraints.
